title: He Does Not Get Out
hook: The Ledger is parked. Mya has the dash.
scene: Rain at midday, a downtown curb you can see from the mesh. The Ledger is parked where he knew you would look — destination sign dark, long-arm mirrors beaded. He does not get out. Mya is a brown mackerel loaf on the dash against the cargo wall, dark stripe, green eyes. The clipboard is on the doghouse between the seats. You idle in the Menace a stall away. Two engines. One cat. He waits for you to see what he already decided.
debrief: Deac came back parked, not walking. Mya has the glass because the bus is still. You took the look he waited for.

source.teaching_target: Deac returns: parked in sight, Mya on the dash only because the Ledger is still, he does not get out.
